content_sections.heading: About IMU Mumbai
content_sections.text: Indian Maritime University is a Central University under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, Government of India. The posts are at its Mumbai Port Campus (L.B.S. CAMSAR & MERI), Hay Bunder Road, Sewri, Mumbai - 400 033, which runs pre-sea courses such as B.Tech (Marine Engineering) and PGDME and post-sea competency, modular and simulator courses, as named in the duties of the faculty posts.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice advertises 20 posts in all across seven posts. It gives no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Desirable qualification for both Faculty posts: Faculty (Nautical Science): AECS and TSTA Course Certificate. Faculty (Marine Engineering): AECS and TSTA Course Certificate. For the Faculty posts, a candidate who does not yet hold the VICT / TOTA Course Certificate may apply with a willingness to complete the course before joining. The notice gives each post a preferred upper age. The application forms ask candidates to state their age as on Oct, 2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: IMU Mumbai Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Teaching / Training to Post-Sea Courses (Competency, Modular & Simulator). Teaching / Training to Pre-sea Courses (B.Tech [Marine Engineering] & PGDME) & Post-Sea Courses (Competency, Modular & Simulator). To instruct students / assist the Faculty in Workshop / Simulators, etc. Maintenance, augmentation and upkeep of Workshop equipment / devices. Training of Inland Vessel Crew. Project-related work. The notice prints one list of responsibilities for both of these posts: Training of Inland Vessel Crew. To instruct students / assist the Faculty in Workshop / Simulators, etc. Maintenance, augmentation and upkeep of Workshop equipment / devices. Project-related work. Maintenance of Gym. Training of cadets / students. Regular upkeep of Gym. Conduct of Gym-related activities.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IMU Mumbai Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications for IMU Mumbai Recruitment 2026 are accepted only by email. The CV must be sent by 18:00 hrs on 30 November 2026 . Prepare a detailed CV containing complete details of your educational qualifications, work experience, special achievements, present address and expected salary. Fill in and sign the bio-data in the IMU-MPC format attached to the notice for your post. Attach all relevant documents to the email. Write the post applied for in the subject of the email. Send the email to [email protected] before 18:00 hrs on 30 November 2026. The bio-data formats attached to the notice, each in Hindi and English, are: Annexure 1: Faculty (Nautical Science) on Contract Annexure 2: Faculty (Marine Engineering) on Contract Annexure 3: Paramedic on Contract Basis Annexure 4: Workshop Instructor (Marine Engineering) on Contract Basis Annexure 5: Workshop Instructor (Electrical Engineering) on Contract Basis Annexure 6: Lab Assistant on Contract Basis The mode of selection is a physical interview. The date of the interview will be intimated to candidates by e-mail.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Detailed CV with educational qualifications, work experience, special achievements, present address and expected salary. All relevant documents. Signed bio-data in the IMU-MPC format for the post applied for. Faculty posts: the form includes a checklist of essential and desirable qualifications, details of sailing experience at management level, teaching / training experience in Maritime Training Institute(s) in India, and a sailing and shore experience sheet (CDC period, rank and days) in chronological order. Paramedic, Workshop Instructor and Lab Assistant posts: the form asks for Aadhar No. and PAN Card No., essential qualification details, experience with total duration, and academic qualifications from Class X onwards.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be admissible for the interview. Each application form carries a signed declaration: if a candidate is found to have concealed or suppressed any information or given false details, the candidature shall be liable to be summarily terminated without notice or compensation. The application forms ask candidates to state the notice period required to join (days / months). The Faculty forms ask whether the candidate meets each essential and desirable requirement (YES/NO) with remarks; the other forms ask whether the candidate meets the qualification, experience and age criteria for the post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IMU Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 20 posts: 07 Faculty (Nautical Science), 05 Faculty (Marine Engineering), 01 Paramedic, 02 Workshop Instructor (Marine Engineering), 02 Workshop Instructor (Electrical Engineering), 02 Lab Assistant (Instructor) and 01 Gym Instructor.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The CV must be sent by email by 18:00 hrs on 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for Faculty (Nautical Science)?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master (Foreign Going) Certificate of Competency issued by the Directorate General of Shipping, at least six months of sailing at Management level within the meaning of STCW Convention, and a VICT / TOTA Course Certificate or willingness to complete it before joining.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is preferably below 62 years for both Faculty posts, below 55 years for Paramedic, below 57 years for the Workshop Instructor and Lab Assistant (Instructor) posts, and below 50 years for Gym Instructor.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for IMU Mumbai faculty posts?
faq.answer: The proposed remuneration for Faculty (Nautical Science), Faculty (Marine Engineering), Paramedic and Gym Instructor is "As per IMU Norms"; the notice prints no amount.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for IMU Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email your detailed CV, all relevant documents and the signed bio-data in the IMU-MPC format to [email protected], with the post applied for written in the subject.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is by physical interview, and candidates will be told the interview date by e-mail.

faq.question: Q8. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be admissible for the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Are these permanent posts?
faq.answer: No. The posts are advertised on contract basis, and the Gym Instructor post is on visiting basis.

faq.question: Q10. What qualification is needed for Workshop Instructor (Marine Engineering)?
faq.answer: A candidate must be a Marine Fitter from Merchant Navy, or a Petty Officer of Marine Engineering Branch from Indian Navy / Coast Guard, or a Near Coastal Voyage (NCV) Class IV Engineer.
